title: ClinicalReTrial: Clinical Trial Redesign with Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2601.00290v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical trials constitute a critical yet exceptionally challenging and costly stage of drug development (\$2.6B per drug), where protocols are encoded as complex natural language documents, motivating the use of AI systems beyond manual analysis. Existing AI methods accurately predict trial failure, but do not provide actionable remedies. To fill this gap, this paper proposes ClinicalReTrial, a multi-agent system that formulates clinical trial optimization as an iterative redesign problem on textual protocols. Our method integrates failure diagnosis, safety-aware modifications, and candidate evaluation in a closed-loop, reward-driven optimization framework. translated_title: ClinicalReTrial：基于自我进化智能体的临床试验重设计
translated_abstract: 临床试验是药物开发中至关重要但极具挑战性且成本高昂的阶段（每种药物成本达26亿美元），试验方案被编码为复杂的自然语言文档，这促使人们使用AI系统来超越人工分析。现有的AI方法能够准确预测试验失败，但无法提供可操作的补救措施。为填补这一空白，本文提出了ClinicalReTrial，这是一个多智能体系统，将临床试验优化表述为对文本方案的迭代重设计问题。我们的方法在闭环、奖励驱动的优化框架中整合了失败诊断、安全感知修改和候选方案评估。通过将结果预测模型作为模拟环境，ClinicalReTrial能够实现低成本评估和密集奖励信号，从而支持持续的自我改进。我们进一步提出了一种分层记忆机制，用于捕获试验内的迭代级反馈，并提炼跨试验的知识。
tldr: 本文提出ClinicalReTrial多智能体系统，将临床试验优化转化为文本方案的迭代重设计问题，通过以结果预测模型为模拟环境的闭环奖励驱动框架，整合失败诊断、安全感知修改和候选评估，实现低成本、可持续的自我改进试验方案优化。
en_tdlr: ClinicalReTrial is a multi-agent system that reformulates clinical trial optimization as an iterative redesign problem on textual protocols, using an outcome prediction model as a simulation environment within a closed-loop, reward-driven framework that integrates failure diagnosis, safety-aware modifications, and candidate evaluation for continuous self-improvement.
